input_scope: Fixed 200 IDs; calendar dates April 1–27, not creation-relative days
method_notes: The two daily charts reuse Notebook 10.1 and 10.3 logic.
Basic histogram and active-day distribution refer to observed IDs, matching the original descriptive Notebook; fixed-cohort stage results retain all 200.
